text:
Sam Wu: Velaris Analytics sent an RFI — they want a capability matrix, security Qs answered, and a 3-week POC plan. Attaches: velaris_rfi.xlsx. Main open items: HSM support level, per-route SLOs, and POC acceptance criteria. Who can own ops + matrix?

Ava Chen: I can take the capability matrix. Will split rows: embeddings, RAG, reranker, latency SLO, caching, KMS/HSM. Mark any HSM/KMS rows for Legal review.

Ravi Kumar: I'll draft a pricing snippet: POC (pro-rated reserved mini-pool), Pilot, Production reserved with commit discounts. Note network & private peering quoted separately.

Leah Summers: Ops asks: what success metrics do we propose? My suggestion: embedding recall >= 0.7 on their sample set, p95 latency < 250ms for chat flows, and stability for 200 concurrent sessions. Will draft acceptance one-pager.

Emily H: Legal: Hosted = managed KMS (no customer HSM). Dedicated = KMS integration + HSM gateway possible. Private = we can support customer HSM appliance but must run architecture & export review. Will redline any HSM specifics. Also state SOC2 Type II; do not claim FedRAMP.

Marcus Q: For POC ops, we need their sample dataset, network connectivity (VPN/peering), and a contact for test queries. Recommend we include an ops runbook with rollback steps and on-call rotations.

Sam Wu: Action items: Ava - CSV matrix, flag legal rows. Ravi - pricing placeholders. Leah - POC acceptance doc. Marcus - ops runbook + throughput numbers. Emily - legal redlines. I'll bundle and aim to send after legal review tomorrow EOD.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: /attachments/velaris_rfi.xlsx (uploader: Sam Wu)

Ava Chen: Uploaded draft CSV: https://s3.redwood.internal/drafts/velaris_matrix_v1.csv — feedback welcome.

Ravi Kumar: Added pricing placeholders to same folder. Ping for exact numbers.

Emily H: Received; routing HSM questions to Sec & Compliance now.

Sam Wu: Thanks team — if Velaris wants a compressed POC start this week, we'll need exec approval. I'll update thread if they respond. :thumbsup:
